title: The rise and fall of david choe a story of art, crime, and comedy
summary: A 2:24 unsourced channel biography package covering artistic roles/style, early life, Slow Jams, Facebook stock, Thumbs Up!, Dirty Hands, publications/institutions, addiction self-report, the DVDASA controversy and BEEF. The transcript receives extensive lexical repair, but biography is not accepted merely because narration is fluent. Birth/family, bibliography, Facebook dates/$200m estimate, itinerary, institution list, admissions and official handles remain verification holds. The massage-therapist/2014-assault sentence is retained as raw narration but rejected as canonical because this artifact supplies no real identified accuser, assault date, report, charge or adjudication and collapses a disputed podcast story. Denial/apology/joking chronology is held for sourced expansion; current/new BEEF language is date-bound.
